benchmark_scope_decision: This source-based benchmark tests what the assigned books establish, including explicit limits. Q27 retains who rolls in full and requires both affected dice ownership and the accurate statement that these books do not expressly designate a physical thrower. It does not require a person to be invented or claim that a mandatory actor, permission or house convention has been recovered. It is a source-limits answer, not an unqualified definite-gameplay-actor assertion.
